title: AgentDrift: A Step-Labeled Benchmark of Injection-Hijacked LLM Agent Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2609.06972v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents complete tasks by issuing sequences of tool calls, and every observation they read is a channel through which an indirect prompt injection can enter. A successful injection has a characteristic shape when the trajectory is read in order: a benign prefix gives way to actions that serve the attacker rather than the user. Existing benchmarks measure whether such attacks succeed against live agents, and existing guard models judge a trace as a whole; no public corpus labels, step by step, where an injection enters a trajectory and which steps it corrupts. We present AgentDrift, a benchmark of 12,536 synthetic tool-call trajectories over five agent domains in which every one of the 71,024 steps carries one of four labels: benign, injection point, hijacked, or failed injection. The corpus contains 4,000 benign, 5,536 attacked, 1,500 failed-attack, and 1,500 hard-negative trajectories; attacked trajectories follow three compliance

translated_title: AgentDrift：注入劫持LLM智能体轨迹的逐步标注基准
translated_abstract: LLM智能体通过发出一系列工具调用来完成任务，而它们读取的每一条观测结果都是间接提示注入进入的通道。当按顺序阅读轨迹时，成功的注入具有特征性的形态：良性前缀会让位于为攻击者而非用户服务的动作。现有的基准衡量此类攻击对运行中的智能体是否成功，而现有的防护模型则是对整条轨迹进行整体判断；目前没有公开语料库逐步标注注入在轨迹中的进入位置以及它破坏了哪些步骤。我们提出了AgentDrift，这是一个包含五个智能体领域、共12,536条合成工具调用轨迹的基准，其中71,024个步骤中的每一步都带有四种标签之一：良性、注入点、被劫持或注入失败。该语料库包含4,000条良性轨迹、5,536条被攻击轨迹、1,500条攻击失败轨迹和1,500条困难负例轨迹；被攻击的轨迹遵循三种合规性……
tldr: 提出了AgentDrift基准，包含五个领域的12,536条合成工具调用轨迹，首次逐步标注了间接提示注入进入LLM智能体轨迹的位置及其破坏的具体步骤。
en_tdlr: We present AgentDrift, a benchmark of 12,536 synthetic tool-call trajectories across five agent domains that, for the first time, provides step-by-step labels identifying where prompt injections enter LLM agent trajectories and which steps they corrupt.
